office.text: At Casagrande Ingeniería we develop structural solutions for architecture projects, integrating technical analysis, building expertise, and close attention to the construction process.
office.whoWeAreText:
We are a structural engineering studio located in Mendoza, Argentina, specialized in the design and development of residential buildings, multi-story buildings, and industrial warehouses.

With a contemporary vision of engineering, we work on projects where technical precision, structural efficiency, and construction quality are integral to the architecture. We approach each project comprehensively, delivering clear, efficient solutions tailored to the specific demands of each commission.
